title: Paying people to raise money: broker-dealer registration (Exchange Act Section 15(a))
rule: A broker, anyone in the business of effecting securities transactions for others, must register with the SEC to induce securities purchases; selling a Regulation D offering is no exception. SEC staff lists finders who locate investors for issuers among those who may need to register, and treats pay tied to a deal's size or outcome as a sign of broker activity. The issuer's own people fit the Rule 3a4-1 safe harbor only if, among other conditions, they get no transaction-based pay.
changeWatch: SEC action on an exemption for finders, amendments to Rule 3a4-1, or new staff guidance on paid solicitors.
